usedFor: Appcues holds onboarding flows and segments, and HubSpot stores the contacts that “Create Contact” adds from them.

bestTemplate.name: “When one or more flows are created” in Appcues, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The action matches on email, so a repeat run updates the contact instead of duplicating it.

watchOut: “New Segment” in Appcues is polling, so contacts reach HubSpot after a scheduled check, not instantly.
